title.hr: DNS: starenje i brisanje zastarjelih zapisa

concept.hr: Vremenske oznake i dva intervala: koji zastarjeli zapisi nestaju i kada
concept.en: Timestamps and two intervals: which stale records disappear, and when

summary.hr: PC2 ode s mreže 1. dan, a prolaz brisanja ga uklanja tek 21. dan. Prekratki intervali brišu zapise uređaja koji su još na mreži.
summary.en: PC2 leaves on day 1, and a scavenging run removes it only on day 21. Intervals that are too short delete records of devices still online.
